learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the ancient Indian art of Natya, blending beautiful acting, dramatic storytelling, and pure emotion to bring powerful tales to life!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Natya is a spectacular traditional Indian art form that combines dance, music, and drama into one big beautiful show. It is like watching a highly energetic movie happen right in front of your eyes on stage!

In Natya, actors use Abhinaya to express deep feelings and tell ancient stories. They use their sparkling eyes, distinct hand gestures, spoken words, and colorful costumes to make the audience feel every emotion.
For thousands of years, Natya has been used to share exciting stories of brave heroes, wise kings, and magical gods. These performances teach us wonderful lessons about truth, kindness, and bravery.

fun_activity.title: 🗣️ The Emotion Dialogue Game
fun_activity.instructions: Pick a very simple sentence like I am going to the market. Try saying it in front of a mirror three times, first with extreme anger, then with overflowing joy, and finally with deep sadness!

quick_recap: ⭐ Natya beautifully mixes dance, music, and acting to create an unforgettable storytelling experience.
⭐ Actors use four types of Abhinaya including body movements and voice to bring powerful characters to life.
